current_protocol_policy: Git synchronizes source, protocols, and small manifests. RunPod holds large datasets, model base, adapters, checkpoints, and training outputs. Local supervision reads only small UTF-8 JSON receipts through LOW_FREQUENCY_RECONCILIATION.
known_runtime_constraint: RunPod /workspace is fuse.g and rejects chmod(0444); large scientific assets are therefore excluded from this current protocol rather than treated as a scientific blocker.
scope: optional infrastructure utility; never a scientific data or checkpoint requirement for FOUNDATION_V2_RECONSTRUCTION_AND_TARGETED_REPAIR_V1
validated_properties: read-only final-audit enforcement where filesystem supports chmod
